provenance.governance.title: Provenance registry governance (test)
provenance.governance.description: An unlinked page where signers of a provenance registry's owner Safe build, check, sign and propose governance transactions on the Sepolia test network.
provenance.governance.heading: Registry governance
provenance.governance.intro: Build the calls only the owner Safe can make, check them against the chain, sign each Safe transaction with your wallet, and propose it to the Safe Transaction Service, where the Safe's other signers approve it.
provenance.governance.notice: Test page. It works only with the two Sepolia test registries and their test Safe. The registry contract is not audited. Publishing records is not done here: an authorized publisher key sends releases as ordinary transactions.

provenance.governance.warning.freeze: Freezing cannot be undone. No release, record, registration or key change can follow. The owner can still delete and transfer ownership.
provenance.governance.warning.declareSuc: Declaring a successor also freezes this registry, permanently. The registry checks only that the successor address holds code.
provenance.governance.warning.transferOw: The new owner gains control of the registry once it accepts. Until then the Safe stays owner and can cancel.
provenance.governance.warning.acceptOwne: The Safe becomes this registry's owner.
provenance.governance.warning.delete: Deletion clears the version's CID, Arweave ID and label from state and cannot be undone. Its hash and lineage stay, and the original transaction stays in Ethereum's history.
provenance.governance.warning.setPublish: A publisher key can open releases and publish records until the Safe revokes it. Everything it publishes stays attributed to it.
provenance.governance.simulate.note: Runs each Safe transaction with eth_simulateV1 against the latest block, with the Safe's threshold set to 1 inside the simulation only. Nothing is signed or sent.
